Heuristic.description:
The cartographer framing personas — ensemble diversity is the breadth
mechanism (design P3, §5/S1).
Heuristic.title: Heuristic

RawAngle.description:
One candidate angle exactly as a cartographer emits it, before merger
dedup. Deliberately has NO numeric relevance prior: assigning priors is the
merger's job (design §5/S1); cartographers give a prose rationale only.

distinctness_rationale.description: Why this is a distinct region and not a variant of another angle.
distinctness_rationale.title: Distinctness Rationale

example_options.description: 2-3 concrete options proving the angle is non-empty — existence proofs, never endorsements.
example_options.title: Example Options

relevance_rationale.description: Estimated-relevance rationale in prose, grounded only in the brief and destination model — never a number, never a ranking.
relevance_rationale.title: Relevance Rationale

RawAngle.title: RawAngle

StrategicNote.description:
A meta-strategy insight that is deliberately NOT an angle.

Selection criteria, goal reframes, and execution/timing tactics are real
levers but not regions a scout can populate with option cards, so they
travel here instead of the angle list. The human at Gate A reads them (and
alone may enact a reframe, per P7/P8); rubric-weight notes feed the S4
rubric-builder; execution notes feed S8 next-actions. This channel never
receives scouting budget.

kind.description: Routing: 'reframe' -> Gate A frame review; 'rubric-weight' -> S4 rubric-builder; 'execution' -> S8 synthesis next-actions.

rationale.description: Why this lever matters, grounded only in the brief and destination model — never in preferences.
rationale.title: Rationale

source_heuristics.description: Filled by the merger: which cartographer framings proposed or corroborated this note. Cartographers leave it empty.
source_heuristics.title: Source Heuristics

StrategicNote.title: StrategicNote

StrategicNoteKind.description: Where a strategic note routes downstream.
StrategicNoteKind.title: StrategicNoteKind

description:
angles/raw/{heuristic} — one cartographer's candidate angles (design §7
lists per-cartographer raw output as a workspace artifact). The merger and
the saturation rule consume these.

angles.description: Target 5-12 candidate angles; fewer than 5 only when the heuristic genuinely yields a narrow harvest (say why in notes).
angles.title: Angles

strategic_notes.description: Secondary channel: up to 3 meta-strategy levers that are not angles. Zero is the right answer when the map is the whole story.
strategic_notes.title: Strategic Notes
